basic.description: The event titled "Understanding Emotional Intelligence" is an online workshop organized by the Institute for Natural Resources. This event focuses on various aspects of emotional intelligence, particularly in relation to mental disorders, wellness, and health and fitness. It aims to provide participants with a deeper understanding of emotional intelligence and its significance in both personal and professional contexts.With a global ranking of 46 and a country ranking of 2, the workshop is recognized for its quality and relevance in the field. In the specific categories, it holds an impressive ranking of 8 in Medical & Pharma and 4 in Wellness, Health & Fitness. The event is tailored for educators, making it particularly relevant for teachers looking to enhance their skills and understanding in handling emotional intelligence within educational settings. The audience reach for this workshop spans across the USA, allowing for a diverse group of participants to engage and learn from the experience.
basic.name: Understanding Emotional Intelligence
